_comment: Maps Sales/marketing SKUs to the canonical Factory shipping part number used for BoM comparison. Both sides are folded to the canonical key before the missing-parts diff so vendor-extended or bundle SKUs on the Sales side and the bare shipping form on the Factory side don't show up as a false shortfall + matching surplus. The VALUE is the canonical Factory form used in current Live Inventory exports (typically the 12-char vendor-extended SKU). Add new pairs as { 'alias_pn': 'canonical_pn' }. Keys are matched case-insensitively after a 1P/P vendor-prefix strip.
_kits_comment: Kit groupings: a kit SKU plus its component SKUs. When ALL components are present on a side (per-site counts > 0 for each), the comparison rolls them into the kit count using min(component counts). If any component is missing on a side, the others stay listed as individual line items — no kit gets created. Spares are tracked separately and don't participate in kit folding.
_excluded_comment: Discontinued / non-comparable SKUs. Dropped from the BoM Compare entirely (Shortfall, Site Allocation, Trace) regardless of which side lists them. Each entry is { 'pn': '...', 'reason': '...' }. Keys matched case-insensitively after 1P/P vendor-prefix strip.
